description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST 'ciaddr' field is 0 in REQUESTING — the requested address is carried in Option 50, NOT the BOOTP fixed header (RFC 2131 §4.3.2 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
In REQUESTING the client has only an OFFER, not yet an ACK; it does not yet own yiaddr. ciaddr therefore stays 0 and the desired IP goes in Option 50 (Requested IP Address). RFC 2131 §4.3.2 makes this split mandatory.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER.
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER.
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • ciaddr == 0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST.ciaddr is all-zero.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_request_ciaddr_not_zero — REQUEST carries non-zero ciaddr

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_request_ciaddr_not_zero: DUT DHCPREQUEST ciaddr is not zero
